CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Equipment__c), ISBLANK(Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__c) ), "Not Covered", IF( AND( TEXT(Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Status__c) = "Active", Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Start_Date__c <= TODAY(), Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__r.End_Date__c >= TODAY() ), "Covered", IF( OR( TEXT(Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Status__c) = "Expired", Equipment__r.Current_Coverage_Plan__r.End_Date__c < TODAY() ), "Expired", "Not Covered" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Coverage Status
